'''Xerxian''' was an individual<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> of [[Human/Legends|Human]] or [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith pureblood]] descent<ref name="Species" /> who held the title of [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Xerxian was assigned to govern the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]] sometime after it was [[Battle of Sullust (Great Galactic War)|captured]] by the Empire during the [[Great Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], but when Xerxian failed to put down a [[Sullust uprising|violent uprising]] among the [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustans]]<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> sometime between [[3681 BBY|3681]] and [[3640 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> he was summoned to a private audience with [[Darth Marr]], a member of the Empire's ruling [[Dark Council]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

After the meeting with the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]], Xerxian dictated a letter of resignation and [[Death/Legends|shot himself]], leaving many to believe that Marr had removed his mask and allowed Xerxian to view his supposedly ruined visage, thereby driving the man insane.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

==Behind the scenes==
Xerxian was mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]'', a reference guide published in [[2012]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" />
